FORMAT LAW. Honour the grammar of the microscope macro world — its native framing, its edit rhythm, and the specific thing audiences expect from it. If the format loops, the last frame must match the first.

CAMERA. Compose 9:16 with the action in the safe centre band. Use a handheld follow with visible micro-shake and breathing correction on a 180mm long macro, framing with dead-centre symmetry with mirrored negative space.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with north-facing window light with a black v-flat for negative fill; grade as a punchy saturated candy palette with hard primaries. Specify the sound design in one clause — what the viewer hears in the first second decides whether they stay.

OUTPUT. Reply with a single continuous prompt paragraph. Never explain, never bullet, never wrap it in markdown fences.
